phase: One fresh complete repeat of frozen v25 on the same 96 known day conditions, run with the plan->purchase resource gate active for the first time. Known development cohort, not a new holdout.
primary: All 96 cells run once with frozen prompt/source/contracts. Preserve every failure. The gate decides whether each plan reaches a purchase call; its exclusions are reported, never repaired. A complete eligible matrix is the pass condition for reading per-mechanism on/off differences at all.
limitations: Prompts are unchanged from the previous round. This run tests the pipeline, not a new prompt candidate.
Explicit synthetic work/school schedules, not observed historical roles.
Only detergent inventory and optional laundry need tracked; no whole household demand claim.
One day, 12 citizens, 1 replicate. No population significance and no empirical policy-effect claim.
A new seed draws new plans; this is not a re-scoring of the previous run's rows.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: No prompt selection or target fitting in this run. No gate on spending amount, laundry completion, desired policy sign or effect size.
